items.title: AI hiring boom could turn into a surprise tailwind for software: Bernstein
items.summary: Investing.com -- Artificial intelligence could prove a surprise tailwind for software companies if productivity gains spur businesses to hire more workers rather than cut headcount, Bernstein analysts said, challenging one of the sector’s key bearish narratives.

items.title: Adobe Sinks 7% as Internal CEO Pick Lands Ahead of Earnings, Workday Falls 4%
items.summary: Adobe named an internal successor days before a scheduled earnings report, and investors are not treating the timing as a coincidence. The question hanging over the stock is whether the new CEO can answer what the AI era actually means for the company's core business.

items.title: Cramer Says This Software Giant Is Fighting a Takeover With a $4 Billion Buyback
items.summary: Silver Lake wants Workday, but Workday just fired back with $4 billion and a packed calendar of public commitments. Jim Cramer says the company is fighting its own takeover, and the five-year chart reveals what investors are actually betting on.
